programs.description: A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.
An orphan returns to her father's ancestral home after her parents' death. However, she is subjected to a vile treatment, forcing her to fight for her rights.
Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.
Achamma and her husband lead a peaceful life abroad. However, their life takes a turn when Achamma returns to her native place and encounters her ex-husband, John.
Kasarkode Khaderbai
When V G Sadanand, the CM of Kerala, is poisoned on 15th August, the case goes to DSP Perumal. However, he soon realises that he is hunting a cunning criminal who leaves no evidence.
Inspired by his father's revolutionary feats, a soldier wages a lone battle against the rampant arms smuggling in his village. However, he pays a heavy price after he is falsely accused of espionage.
An intense rivalry ensues between two brothers after their daughters fall in love with their driver. However, things take a drastic turn after their rivalry becomes a matter of their family prestige.
Ninamaninja Kalpadukal
When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.
Smuggler Simon Peter falls in love with Alice. However, he becomes the target of a gangster when he tries to cease the illegal activities carried out in the neighbourhood.
Ravi Varman, a psychiatrist, treats only one patient at a time and that too in isolation. When he learns that his former patient Yamuna is getting married, he decides to meet her.
A man borrows money to go to Dubai and assures his moneylenders visas and jobs in return. Instead, he vanishes and promises to reopen a mill that has been shut down when they demand their money back.
Kuruppinte Kanakku Pustakom
Ajit, an anchor in Kolkata, meets Krishnapriya, who has lost her husband under mysterious circumstances. However, things become complicated when he falls for her while helping to find her spouse.
3 Char Sau Bees
Mayamayooram
Two friends, Nandakumar and Shashank, are in a desperate need of money. They decide to get their hands on some cash through unfair means.
An honest police officer decides to avenge his family after his wife gets raped and his daughter suffers a bullet wound. He kills the man who is responsible for this, thus, starting a chain reaction.
Falsely accused and punished for a theft he did not commit, Vasu turns to a life of crime. Angry and frustrated, he then dares the public prosecutor to punish him again.
